profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary: Specialties: Software development, software design, personal software process (PSP), software testing, distributed systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Making data and tools more powerful with applied statistics, ML and proper abstractions between storage, compute, and visualizations. Root cause analysis, forecasting, event correlation, anomaly… all at massive scale and used by our AI agents.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Software Engineer and Tech Lead (3 years), then Engineering Manager (2 years) of Scuba, the Realtime Analytics platform at Facebook.

Scuba - a fast, scalable, distributed, in-memory database (ingestion + storage + query engine) built at Facebook used for most real-time analysis.
https://research.fb.com/publications/scuba-diving-into-data-at-facebook/
https://research.fb.com/publications/fast-database-restarts-at-facebook/

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Windows Runtime Experience. 
Working on the developer surface for the next generation of Windows, including the asynchronous programming pattern to be used from C++/.NET/JS (http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/hh191443(v=VS.110).aspx) and the core application foundation for Metro apps (http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/apps/br205865.aspx).

positions.description: Developed a system which includes a mobile application for the health care sector using Microsoft technologies
